title: Media config
description: media-config.json: the only list of media origins and asset size limits. The content build checks video URLs and asset files against it, and #20 generates the Content-Security-Policy from it. The origins must also pass the extra checks in src/media-config.ts (exactly what new URL(origin).origin returns, no repeats).

mediaOrigins.description: https origins of files on the media CDN (img-src and media-src).

embeds.description: Video sites that may be embedded as a frame (frame-src).

origin.description: The https origin of the embed player.

pathPrefix.description: The path before the video ID, with a slash at both ends.

idPattern.description: A regular expression for the video ID, from ^ to $.

watchHosts.description: Hosts of the site's watch pages, which are rejected with a hint to use the embed URL.

imageBytes.description: The most bytes of an image file (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .svg).

modelBytes.description: The most bytes of a model file (.glb, .gltf).

captionBytes.description: The most bytes of a captions file (.vtt).
